- Chinese explanation — pass: 解释.md (SHA-256 {explain_hash}) describes those three included items, the missing fields, the literal relative date, and both exclusions without contradiction.
- The independent executable review at check_package_output.py (SHA-256 {checker_hash}) returned pass in source-checker.json (SHA-256 {checker_record_hash}).
